title: Audit PR5017 on native Windows and expose its CRLF test failure
body:
PR #5017 leaves native Windows execution open. This audit of its exact head `baab49ce64e6c170ad74432992a35a9c4a54be92` supplies a native six-process failure probe and finds a concrete test portability defect: the ordinary-failure fixture prints CRLF on Windows while its assertion requires LF-only bytes. The runner preserves the emitted bytes correctly.

The isolated contribution is [the audit note, reproducible probe, exact source manifest and evidence](https://github.com/mihir-s-05/integer-mult-bounds/tree/e07130d87da442d6b778c7d2c391c019174ba22d/docs/research/windows-worker-failure-audit). A tested two-line fixture patch writes explicit binary stdout and preserves the exact-byte assertion. It is supplied for #5017's owner to incorporate; no production runner or predecessor test is changed here.

Validation on CPython 3.12.0 x64 / Windows 11 build 26300:

- Normal and optimized native probes pass for `OSError`, `StopIteration` and `SystemExit`. All six retained process handles signal exit before independent teardown; the original exception object propagates. An input-ordered waiting mutant needs the six-second safety release in both modes.
- The unchanged new regression has one pass, one CRLF failure and six POSIX-only skips. The binary-output fixture patch yields two passes and six skips in both modes.
- The existing isolated-test group reports 42 passes and eight platform skips (63.713 s), exit zero, followed by a destructor-time `Popen` ResourceWarning. The transcript preserves this unresolved warning; no warning-free compatibility claim is made.
- The exporter authenticates ten source files by Git blob and SHA-256. The probe checks them before and after replay. An actual changed-source control rejects under `-O`; both export trees are unchanged afterward. All 13 publication files match the tested staged bytes, and `git diff --check` passes.
- Selected orientation passes `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`. No full CI plan, historical scientific package, selected cold replay or other platform/version was run.

Base and final canonical refresh: `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1`, priority revision 7. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1472#discussioncomment-19140253). Final overlap covers 328 open PRs, 4,137 Discussion records and all 6,710 local notes; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside coverage. The concurrent Unicode command-transport claim is a distinct boundary.

Credit JoyboyBrian's #5017/#4779/#4975, Nick Petalas's runner/readiness fixtures, Mihir Srivastava's #4683 native observer/caller, ywz65's gated Job Object lineage, Paul Romeo, yssite, Douglas Colkitt and retained contributors. Prepared for Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent; Apache-2.0. This account authored #4683, so independent authorship of that machinery is not claimed. No new kappa, scientific acceptance, selected-frontier change, merge or closure.

Open next questions: incorporate the portable fixture write into #5017, rerun it on Windows/POSIX, and attribute the post-summary warning with a focused fixture reproduction before proposing cleanup changes.
